title: Digital Galvanizing System
summary: Track galvanizing project status, scheduling, and production progress with the AZZ Digital Galvanizing System (DGS).
body_markdown:
## Technology-driven visibility across galvanizing operations


AZZ's Digital Galvanizing System (DGS) gives customers real-time visibility into production status, scheduling, and project progress throughout the galvanizing process. By improving planning, communication, and logistics coordination, DGS helps customers make informed decisions and keep projects moving efficiently. The platform reflects AZZ's continued investment in technologies that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and service responsiveness across its extensive metal coatings network.


[Contact AZZ](https://www.azz.com/contact-us) to learn more about DGS capabilities, customer access, and available tracking and reporting features.
